integrity.failed_gate: Every three-symbol median fifteen-minute return must be finite and nonzero.

finding: Five official releases produced an exact zero median under the frozen three-index return rule. Four had US500 unchanged while US30 and US100 had opposite signs; one Employment release had US100 and US500 both unchanged. Therefore one common LONG or SHORT shock state cannot be assigned to all 96 releases under the declared semantics.
economic_interpretation: No claim is made about whether shock-aligned or shock-opposed entries are good or bad. The unit stopped before role density and before any lifecycle stressed-R or stop outcome was opened.
closed_scope: No dropping the five neutral events or using only events that have a later birth.
